lesson: The task's three-lens review (forge review: quality/performance/security lenses, all P2 and up) accepted SEVEN findings; fix exactly these, one pinned test each, then run npx tsc --noEmit, npm run check:architecture and the touched suites (permission-decision-coordinator, permission-human-memory-stage, application/permission-card-affordances, channels/permission-card-affordances, channels/permission-interaction, provider-affordance-parity). Security P1s: (1) apps/core/src/runtime/permission-decision-coordinator.ts:262-312 — `exactAllowCanOverride` opens the remembered-allow path for EVERY Destructive ask; the job-projection branch at :267 checks `railDecision?.hardFloor !== true` but the chat-side `consultRememberedAllow` at :298 does not, so a hard-floor destructive request can be auto-approved from an exact memory on repetition. Hoist ONE hard-floor guard so that when `railDecision.hardFloor === true` neither lookup runs and the rail prompt is mandatory (same family as the T4 fix: the guard belongs at every gate of the shared predicate); also make sure the remember context for such a request is ineligible so nothing is stored (check permission-human-memory-stage / the remember-context derivation and pin it if it is not already so). Pin: hard-floor destructive ask with a matching exact allow in memory → no human_decision approval, prompt raised; the same ask without hardFloor → the existing behaviour. (2) apps/core/src/channels/permission-interaction.ts:62 — the re-export of `permissionDecisionOptions` from the new affordance module is a retained import surface; delete it and point every caller (and test) at `channels/permission-card-affordances.ts` directly. (3) permission-interaction.ts:636 — `userFacingToolLabel` is a one-line wrapper over `permissionHumanToolLabel`; delete it and update its callers (and tests) to the owner. The task contract forbids wrappers, re-exports, aliases and retained symbols (NO LEFTOVERS). Quality P2s: (4) apps/core/src/channels/permission-card-affordances.ts:35 — `permissionCardDecisionOptions` appends a denial only when `remember_deny_exact` is offered, so an eligible card whose deny candidate is refused has no way to say no; render the scalar `cancel` labelled "No" whenever the remembered denial cannot be offered (keep the button order Allow / alternative / once / No). (5) apps/core/src/application/permissions/permission-card-affordances.ts:176 — the trust-growth branch never checks `rememberContext.candidates.kindTool.ok`; require a usable kindTool candidate before offering `remember_allow_kind` (otherwise the receipt says Remembered while learning stores nothing). (6) application/permissions/permission-card-affordances.ts:284 — the write predicate recognises only `FileWrite`/`FileEdit`; use the canonical write classification so `Write`, `Edit` and `MultiEdit` public identities with a write path get write-scope copy. Performance P2: (7) apps/core/src/runtime/permission-human-memory-stage.ts:52 — the default path awaits the exact candidate before deriving the other candidates; branch on `exactOnly` first and otherwise derive exact, kind, kindTool and place together in one `Promise.all` as before (pin: with exactOnly false all candidate derivations start before any resolves). The orchestrator commits, never you.
